d: Marine Le Pen sits down with IGR for an exclusive interview ahead of France’s presidential election. In a wide-ranging conversation, she speaks about the protests gripping France, immigration and Islam, and whether Islamist fundamentalism is compatible with the values of the French Republic. Le Pen also discusses France’s relationship with India, New Delhi’s strategic autonomy and its ties with Russia. She shares her views on Prime Minister Narendra Modi, US President Donald Trump and the debate over women in political leadership. Here are the five biggest takeaways from IGR’s exclusive…
